name: Build Reproducibility Inspector
description: Build a staged fixture twice in fenced contexts, compare artifact hashes and explain timestamp or path nondeterminism.
author: Sara team

es.Build a staged fixture twice in fenced c: Compila dos veces un proyecto preparado en contextos aislados, compara los hashes de los artefactos y explica diferencias de hora o ruta.

fr.Build Reproducibility Inspector: Inspection de la reproductibilité des builds
fr.Build a staged fixture twice in fenced c: Compile deux fois un projet préparé dans des contextes isolés, compare les empreintes des artefacts et explique les écarts d’heure ou de chemin.

de.Build a staged fixture twice in fenced c: Baut ein vorbereitetes Projekt zweimal in abgegrenzten Kontexten, vergleicht die Artefakt-Hashes und erklärt Zeit- oder Pfadunterschiede.

pt-BR.Build a staged fixture twice in fenced c: Compila duas vezes um projeto preparado em contextos isolados, compara os hashes dos artefatos e explica diferenças de horário ou caminho.

it.Build a staged fixture twice in fenced c: Compila due volte un progetto preparato in contesti isolati, confronta gli hash degli artefatti e spiega le differenze di orario o percorso.
